suggestions.reasoning: As artificial intelligence and automation reshape labor markets, manual craftsmanship requiring fine motor skills, physical material manipulation, and specialized physical repairs remains highly resilient against automation. According to McKinsey & Company (2023), while cognitive and routine tasks face high exposure to generative AI, physical dexterity tasks in niche luxury sectors are largely shielded. Furthermore, leveraging digital tools for online showcases addresses the shrinking local market by expanding reach beyond physical storefronts, aligning with TopCV & GSO (2024) insights on digital channel integration.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your 15 years of mechanical watchmaking experience, absolute patience, and exceptional precision directly match the requirements of high-end mechanical horology. By addressing your weakness in online sales through basic digital literacy, you can transition your local reputation into a broader digital storefront while maintaining your core technical strengths.
transferableSkillsMatch: Handling of Swiss and Japanese watch components
skillsGap: Basic online marketing and customer outreach

evidenceCitations.paperTitle: The economic potential of generative AI: The next productivity frontier
